meta.name: add-deltachat
meta.description: Add DeltaChat channel integration via @deltachat/stdio-rpc-server. Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge. Email-based messaging with end-to-end encryption.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 接入端到端加密的邮件消息通道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你要在应用中接入端到端加密邮件消息。
copy.tagline_en: Add an email-based encrypted messaging channel to your app.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to add an email-based encrypted messaging channel to your app.

howto.what: 装上后,机器人会多出一个DeltaChat通道,通过email收发加密消息,可以私聊或群聊。安装会自动加入适配器代码并注册,之后需要配置邮箱账号和IMAP/SMTP等参数。
howto.when: 当用户请求为机器人添加DeltaChat通道(如说“接入DeltaChat”或“添加DeltaChat邮箱”)时触发,会启动安装:从git分支取出适配器、注册导入、安装依赖,并引导配置邮箱和IMAP/SMTP。

say.note: 会拉取适配器文件、注册通道并安装依赖包。
把邮箱凭证写入.env,之后能收发加密消息。

say.text: 帮我把这个DeltaChat私聊用/init-first-agent接起来
say.note: 会创建agent组、授权owner并绑定消息组。

howto.what_en: After installation, the bot gains a DeltaChat channel: it sends and receives encrypted messages over email, supporting 1:1 DMs and groups. The setup adds adapter code and registration, then requires email and IMAP/SMTP credentials.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to add a DeltaChat channel (e.g., “add DeltaChat” or “set up DeltaChat email”). It copies the adapter, registers it, installs the package, and asks for IMAP/SMTP credentials.

say_en.text: Please add a DeltaChat channel to the bot.

say_en.note: Creates agent group, grants owner, binds messaging group.
